panels.title: Test 2: Index Scan

targets.rawSql:
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT u.name, u.email, o.total, o.status
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE u.age > 30 AND o.status = 'completed'
ORDER BY o.total DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.description: Aggregation query - tests GROUP BY visualization

targets.rawSql:
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT u.country, COUNT(*) as user_count, AVG(o.total) as avg_total
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.country
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
ORDER BY avg_total DESC;

panels.title: Test 4: Aggregation with GROUP BY

panels.description: Complex CTE query - tests nested plan visualization

targets.rawSql:
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE)
WITH recent_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(total) as total_spent, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE created_at > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT u.name, u.email, u.country, ro.total_spent, ro.order_count
FROM users u
JOIN recent_orders ro ON u.id = ro.user_id
WHERE ro.total_spent > 100
ORDER BY ro.total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Test 5: CTE Query

panels.description: Multi-table join - tests complex join tree

targets.rawSql:
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT u.name, o.id as order_id, p.name as product_name, oi.quantity, oi.price
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE u.country = 'USA' AND p.category = 'Electronics'
LIMIT 50;
